Role :

Operations Manager (Salon, Spa, and Aesthetic industry - MUST) Role Specifics :

Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.

What You'll Do

As the Operations Manager, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it's not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth, and collaborative improvement. As the Operations Manager, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You'll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder's priorities aligned. This hands‑on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail.

Operations & Integrator Coordination : 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management – Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day‑to‑day operations and overall team integration. Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution. Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals. Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1 : 1s; take notes and follow up on action items. Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery. Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed. Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder. Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics. Create and maintain an easy‑to‑follow Operations Playbook.

System Management & Process Oversight – Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc. Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget. Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.

Marketing & Content Coordination : 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination – Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track. Oversee the submission and of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.

Content Curation & Social Media Management – Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives. Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone. Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.

Strategic Founder & Client Support : 10% Role Allocation

Own the Founder's calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates. Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow‑ups. Turn the Founder's ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks. Protect the Founder's time while supporting the team and aligning priorities. Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow‑ups and building relationships.

What You Should Have Must-haves

At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C‑level or Founder Executives. Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Salon, Spa, Aesthetic, or Wellness brand, particularly in fast‑paced, multi‑business environments. At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE. Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high‑level strategies into actionable plans and workflows. Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence. Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross‑functional teams, and manage day‑to‑day operations. Client‑facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships. Hands‑on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling / inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates. Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms. Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams). Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp. Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos). Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch. Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.

Technology Specifications

Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed Windows 11 or macOS 15 Sequoia Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM Webcam and Headset Designated Quiet Office Space

Nice‑to‑haves

Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS. Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.

Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who : Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead. Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what's not working, and helping build smoother systems. Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence. Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.

Contract

You will work closely with functional consultants and key customer resources, gathering requirements through workshops, building conversion objects, and driving your team’s value through all data project phases. You will be responsible for making sure that your team uses your data skills and the Syniti data management platform to assess and iterate through design, build, and deployment, ensuring that the highest customer value is derived from your assigned objects. As a lead member of a Syniti Data Migration team, you will execute against the best practices for successful business transformation and become skilled in the strongest platform to meet all of our customer’s needs.

This role has been designated as a remote position, allowing qualified talent throughout the listed country to be considered for the opportunity.

After an initial training period, a Lead Data Migration Consultant will be expected to :

  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of Syniti’s Data Migration methodology.
  • Demonstrate strong proficiency in Syniti’s tools, working to prescribed development standards.
  • Good understanding of business processes for one or more assigned functional area, and the ability to quickly learn about new areas.
  • Effectively manage a small team of data migration consultants, to meet assigned responsibilities against the overall project plan.

  • Evaluate and contribute to ongoing data migration design for assigned process area through data analysis, reporting and collaboration with on-site Syniti and client colleagues.
  • Create and maintain data load programs.
  • Maintain related documentation and clearly communicate status to Syniti Team Leadership and customer PMO.
  • Execution of end-to-end data loads and reconciliations.
  • Support and mentor junior colleagues.

WHAT IT TAKES

  • Degree level qualification in Computer Science (or other technology related field).
  • Experience in ETL / Data Migration / Data Quality / Data Analysis.
  • Experience managing resources to deliver a collective goal / responsibility.
  • Functional ERP experience.
  • Project experience across multiple ERP implementations.
  • Database experience - SQL Server, Oracle etc.
  • Customer facing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel according to project requirements up to 100%.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Autonomy and Trust : Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, with minimal micromanagement.
  • Growth Opportunities : We are growing rapidly, offering you the chance to grow with us, shape our journey, and share in our success story.
  • Collaborative Support : We value collaboration and support each other, ensuring you won’t stand alone in your endeavors.
  • Diversity of Stories : Genuine interest in your unique story and journey. We celebrate individual achievements and want to hear everyone's story.
  • Recognition : We appreciate and celebrate individual achievements, acknowledging the contribution of each team member.
  • Open Organization : We embrace an open and inclusive culture, where hierarchies are minimized, and access is ensured across the board. Everyone is valued, and ideas are welcomed.

Missão

Buscamos um(a) especialista com sólida formação em Ciência da Informação e atuação estratégica em gestão do conhecimento, curadoria digital e inteligência informacional – com foco em ambientes institucionais, públicos ou científicos.

Responsabilidades

  • Mapear e qualificar ativos informacionais institucionais

  • Articular-se com diferentes áreas para promover o uso compartilhado e estratégico de dados e informações
  • Apoiar a formulação de políticas e diretrizes relacionadas à gestão e circulação de informações no contexto público
  • Identificar oportunidades para desenvolvimento de projetos e iniciativas baseadas em inteligência informacional
  • Estimular práticas de transparência, memória institucional e fortalecimento da cultura informacional

Experiência desejável

Experiência em projetos institucionais, políticas públicas ou ambientes de pesquisa e inovação. Atuação prévia com memória institucional, curadoria de informações ou gestão do conhecimento. Conhecimento de metodologias de planejamento estratégico ou modelagem de projetos. Familiaridade com ambientes governamentais, redes de ensino e ciência, tecnologia e inovação.

Formação exigida

  • Ciência da Informação
  • Jornalismo
  • Comunicação Social
  • Biblioteconomia (ênfase em dados, curadoria ou memória)

Pós-Graduação desejável

  • Ciencia da Informação
  • Gestão do Conhecimento
  • Governança da Informação
  • Inteligência Competitiva
  • Curadoria Digital e Preservação de dados

Certificações relevantes

  • Gestão da Informação e do Conhecimento — Knowledge Management Certification (KMI – Knowledge Management Institute)
  • AIIM Certified Information Professional (CIP)
  • ARMA Information Governance Professional (IGP)
  • Curadoria, Dados e Repositórios Digitais — Data Stewardship & FAIR Data (GO FAIR Initiative, CODATA ou DANS Academy)
  • Open Science Framework (OSF) Training
  • Research Data Management (RDMLA, Coursera ou OpenAIRE)

Habilidades e competências técnicas

  • Organização e recuperação da informação (metadados, taxonomias, ontologias, vocabulários controlados)
  • Curadoria de dados e gestão de repositórios institucionais
  • Conhecimento de padrões internacionais (Dublin Core, MARC, ISO, FAIR Principles)
  • Alfabetização em dados (data literacy) e análise básica de dados informacionais
  • Políticas de informação, ética e segurança da informação
  • Gestão do conhecimento e aprendizagem organizacional
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como DSpace, KOHA, Power BI, OpenRefine, Zotero, Mendeley, entre outras

Ferramentas e ambientes desejáveis

  • DSpace
  • Koha
  • Zotero
  • Mendeley
  • Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300)
  • OpenRefine
  • Repositórios digitais e bases de dados científicas
  • Google Data Analytics (Coursera)

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em gestão de acervos digitais ou portais de informação científica
  • Atuação em governança de dados, gestão documental e compliance informacional
  • Produção científica e participação em redes ou fóruns de ciência aberta e dados FAIR
  • Inglês técnico e leitura de artigos científicos internacionais

Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Department: Customer & Professional Services

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industry. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best‑in‑class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company’s deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.

Forecasting and Talent Management

  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold‑to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and elevate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

title: Principal Consultant – SOC Transformation and XSIAM Deployment
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full‑scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi‑national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI‑driven platform
  • Direct enterprise‑scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high‑quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine‑tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high‑performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Qualifications

A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI‑driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR

Your Experience

  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands‑on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands‑on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus

Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)

  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry‑recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post‑sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission. You’ll be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and fixing integrations and critical issues as they are raised. But you won’t wait for them to be raised, you’ll seek them out, too. We fix and identify technical problems with a pointed focus of providing the best customer support in the industry.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

Account Manager (Part-time, Remote)

Uniqlo Agency

At Uniqlo Agency, we don’t like unnecessary complexity. Our mission is to simplify the entire customer journey from awareness to conversion by building and managing digital accounts strategically, efficiently, and transparently.

  • Fully remote position with flexible working hours.

We’re not looking for someone to fill a role. We’re looking for an Account Manager who truly understands clients, data, and isn’t afraid to speak up in order to drive results.

Apply if you’re ready to create real value, not just “manage accounts.”

title: FONOAUDIOLOGO
description:
Job description

Há 86 anos, a Fundação José Silveira mantém o olhar voltado para o futuro, reinventando suas práticas em um mundo imprevisível, sem perder de vista suas raízes sólidas naquilo que é a origem do propósito: cuidar da saúde e melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas.

Com isso, buscamos pessoas conectadas ao novo que venham contribuir com o constante crescimento e a perpetuação do nosso legado.

Junte-se ao nosso propósito!

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar atendimento fonoaudiológico à beira do leito em todas as unidades do hospital, com enfoque em disfagia, linguagem, voz e motricidade orofacial;
  • Auxiliar a elaboração do Manual Administrativo Técnico, a fim de normatizar o funcionamento do serviço, suas rotinas e ações assistenciais;
  • Apoiar na implementação dos kits de alimentação para avaliação, em conjunto com a nutrição, a fim de favorecer a rotina do serviço e a evolução do paciente, diminuindo o tempo de intervalo para realizada das avaliações e introdução de via oral dos mesmos, acelerando o processo de desmame de via alternativa de alimentação, com a finalidade de favorecer a redução de custos com a dieta enteral e com a desospitalização do paciente;
  • Participar da passagem de plantão do serviço, onde são discutidos os casos dos pacientes, assegurando a resolução e condução dos mesmos de forma multidisciplinar e garantindo a uniformidade das condutas;
  • Preencher as planilhas de mapas de paciente em atendimento, sendo preenchidos diariamente, a fim de fazer o controle de atendimentos e quantidade de pacientes em cada unidade, onde também são registrados todas as informações sobre quadro clínico do paciente, assim como estabelecidas e registradas condutas e observações para cada condução do caso;
  • Realizar a evolução fonoaudiológica no sistema, com o objetivo de otimizar a rotina do serviço e comunicação entre a equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Colaborar junto à nutrição e enfermagem da terapia nutricional na construção da Cartilha da Nutrição Enteral, a fim de realizar educação em saúde nas unidades, através do treinamento da equipe sobre desmame via alternativa de alimentação e introdução de via oral de forma segura e eficaz;
  • Dar suporte junto a nutrição e enfermagem da terapia nutricional nos treinamentos da EMTN, a fim de realizar educação em saúde nas unidades, através do treinamento da equipe sobre desmame via alternativa de alimentação e introdução de via oral de forma segura e eficaz.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino superior completo em Fonoaudiologia;
  • Desejável especialização na área;
  • Experiência na área hospitalar;
  • CREFONO ativo.

title: Network & Security Operations Analyst
description:
Responsibilities：

1. Design, implement, and manage network segmentation between IT and OT domains, ensuring compliance with zero-trust and defense-in-depth principles.

2. Configure and maintain high-availability firewalls, redundant paths, and routing failover policies across data centers and remote sites.

3. Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) for major network or or security incidents and produce corrective-action plans.

4. Develop and maintain network addressing plans, DHCP scopes, NAT rules, and routing policies to guarantee scalability and consistency.

5. Oversee vulnerability remediation activities and validate the effectiveness of penetration-test mitigation actions.

6. Integrate security device logs into SIEM, coordinate with SOC for event correlation and incident escalation.

7. Perform periodic configuration audits and enforce change-management best practices (RFC approval, rollback validation, and documentation).

8. Define and maintain technical standards for VLAN naming, access control, and monitoring configurations.

9. Mentor junior and mid-level analysts, conducting knowledge-transfer sessions and technical training workshops.

10. Coordinate network readiness activities for plant expansions, data-center upgrades, and cloud integrations.

11. Prepare and present monthly KPI and performance dashboards, highlighting trends in latency, availability, and incident rates.

12. Represent the Network Operations function during internal and external audits, ensuring evidence of compliance with ISO 27001 controls.

13. Participate in policy reviews and contribute to global infrastructure standardization with BYD Global IT.

14. Conduct disaster-recovery testing and validate failover mechanisms to ensure business continuity.

Required Quality：

1. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Networks, Information Security, or Telecommunications.

2. Minimum of 6 years of experience in enterprise network design, administration, or security operations.

3. Advanced knowledge of routing, switching, VPN, and firewall management across multi-vendor environments.

4. Proven experience with segmentation projects separating OT and IT environments.

5. Hands‑on expertise with firewalls, IDS / IPS, NAC, and SIEM platforms (Fortinet, Cisco, or Palo Alto).

6. Deep understanding of network availability, latency, and performance metrics (MTTD / MTTR).

7. Proficiency in network troubleshooting using packet‑capture and analysis tools (Wireshark, NetFlow).

8. Strong ability to manage incident response, root‑cause analysis, and postmortem reporting.

9. Familiarity with ISO 2701, NIST, and LGPD security controls applied to network operations.

10. Fluent English for documentation, reporting, and technical meetings;

11. Excellent leadership and mentoring skills to guide junior and mid-level analysts.

12. Certifications preferred : Cisco CCNP, Fortinet NSE6, or equivalent professional‑level credentials.

13. Solid understanding of EHS and NR compliance, ensuring safe interventions in critical environments.

14. Strong analytical thinking and ability to standardize processes across multiple sites.

15. Availability for travel and participation in corporate audits and cross‑site projects.

Mandarin is an advantage.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga

unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de

serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. Overview

We’re looking for a hands‑on security leader who can build, manage, and scale Pointsville’s security and compliance programs. This role is ideal for someone capable of designing enterprise‑grade security programs, engineering security tools, and embedding best practices into fast‑moving development environments.

What You’ll Do

Security Strategy, Leadership & Program Development

  • Build and lead Pointsville’s global security and compliance function from the ground up.
  • Develop and implement the company‑wide security strategy, policies, and frameworks aligned with business and regulatory goals.
  • Conduct organization‑wide risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and incident response exercises.
  • Drive security awareness and training programs to strengthen company‑wide accountability.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure security goals align with organizational priorities.

Technical Security Engineering

  • Lead the design and development of advanced security testing and monitoring platforms, including distributed fuzzing systems and validation frameworks.
  • Conduct secure architecture reviews and threat modeling for infrastructure, APIs, smart contracts, and cloud‑native services.
  • Integrate Secure SDLC practices into CI / CD pipelines—automating vulnerability discovery, testing, and compliance reporting.
  • Perform deep‑dive analysis of vulnerabilities, exploits, and mitigations across web, mobile, and blockchain systems.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to ensure secure‑by‑design implementation in infrastructure‑as‑code and deployments.

Cloud, Infrastructure & Data Protection

  • Oversee cloud security architecture (AWS preferred), including network segmentation, IAM, and continuous monitoring.
  • Manage VPNs, multi‑region access, and secret management tools (Vault, KMS, etc.).
  • Ensure data privacy and protection measures are embedded in all systems and products.
  • Lead investigations, containment, and response in the event of security incidents or data breaches.

Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Develop and maintain security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA.
  • Prepare and manage internal and external audits and certifications.
  • Identify, document, and mitigate enterprise security and compliance risks.
  • Establish a “privacy by design” and “security by default” culture in collaboration with legal and product teams.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Serve as the main point of contact for all internal and external security and compliance matters.
  • Partner cross‑functionally with Product, Engineering, and Operations to align security controls with business needs.
  • Deliver clear reporting and recommendations to leadership on security posture, incidents, and ongoing improvements.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of hands‑on experience in security engineering, product security, or infrastructure security roles.
  • Proven track record designing and deploying security tools and frameworks at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cryptography, secure protocols, and key management systems.
  • Expertise in AWS, Docker / Kubernetes, and large‑scale distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of application security (OWASP, STRIDE, TARA) and vulnerability mitigation.
  • Proficiency in one or more system languages (Java, C, C++, Rust, Go) and one scripting language (Python, Shell).
  • Experience with blockchain and smart contract security preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate security controls, conduct penetration testing, and perform design reviews.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross‑functional teams.

We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

About the company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.

About the opportunity

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a dynamic environment, leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform. In this role, you will participate in automating infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications, and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and enhance system reliability and performance across multi‑cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a fast‑paced, collaborative DevOps environment.

work MST or PST hours.

What you get to do every day

  • Participate in an on‑call rotation on a regular basis and respond to incidents reliably and professionally.
  • Maintain and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure, employing automation, and infrastructure‑as‑code using Terraform.
  • Build and maintain our code pipelines, designing and building automation in order to enable agile software development, using self‑service where possible.
  • Collaborate efficiently and effectively with other team members and Software Engineers to solve complex problems.
  • Quickly absorb context and knowledge while ramping up.

Minimum Requirements

  • 4‑6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role
  • Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP
  • Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes
  • Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)
  • Familiarity with declarative infrastructure‑as‑code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)

Desired Skills (Nice to Haves)

  • Experience with software development and automation in languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir, java, etc.)
  • Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments
  • Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes
  • Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)
  • Working knowledge of UNIX‑based Operating Systems
  • Computer Science or Engineering degree

Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.

Sobre o Cargo : Product Manager Especialista em Cobrança

Principais atividades

Gestão de produtos financeiros estratégicos, com foco em meios de pagamentos.

Responsável por criar e manter o roadmap dos produtos e soluções de meios de pagamento, alinhando-o com a estratégia da empresa e com as necessidades do mercado.

Gerir o ciclo de vida do produto, atuando em todas as fases : concepção, desenvolvimento, lançamento, crescimento, maturidade e encerramento.

Apoiar a definição de pricing, go-to-market e posicionamento dos produtos, em parceria com as áreas de marketing e comercial.

Definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo a entrega de valor para os cooperados por meio da estruturação de histórias de usuário e épicos bem definidos.

Responsável em conduzir o Discovery de produto, analisando a causa raiz das dores dos usuários, levantando hipóteses e validando ideias para garantir que as soluções sejam aderentes às necessidades dos cooperados, direcionando o desenvolvimento do produto para o resultado desejado e ajudando a remover os obstáculos que possam impedir a entrega esperada.

Liderar times ágeis, garantindo entregas eficientes e alinhadas às expectativas dos cooperados.

Definir e acompanhar métricas de produto e análise de dados para tomada de decisão baseada em evidências.

Monitorar tendências do mercado financeiro, regulatórias e tecnológicas para manter os produtos competitivos.

Garantir conformidade com regulamentações do BACEN e demais órgãos reguladores.

Atuar na integração de APIs e novos parceiros para ampliar a oferta de serviços.

Realizar benchmarking, acompanhando tendências de mercado e a concorrência para propor a criação e melhorias.

Responsável por liderar times multidisciplinares, como no entendimento das dificuldades, definição das estratégias e valor entregue dos produtos e priorização.

Responsável por fazer a ponte entre negócios, tecnologia e design. buscando o equilíbrio para o desenvolvimento de produtos digitais.

Garantir que o Backlog do Produto seja visível, transparente e claro para todos.

Participar de homologações, validando as soluções implementadas e garantindo a entrega de valor esperada.

Organização e priorização de tarefas : Capacidade de levantar e detalhar requisitos, incluindo especificações funcionais para desenvolvimento.

Requisitos desejados

Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis : Scrum, Kanban, Lean, SAFe.

Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de produto / projetos : Jira, Miro, Confluence.

Elaboração e gestão de backlog : saber escrever histórias de usuário, critérios de aceite, priorizar com base em valor de negócio.

Conhecimento em tecnologia : Familiaridade com integrações bancárias, gateways e APIs.

Análise de dados e métricas de produto : Habilidade analítica para interpretar métricas, identificar oportunidades e direcionar melhorias nos produtos digitais (Google Analytics, Hotjar, Amplitude, Power BI etc.)

Conhecimento em produtos financeiros : especialmente relacionados gestão dos produtos e soluções de meios de pagamentos (TED / DOC, boletos, carteiras digitais, adquirência, recorrência, split de pagamentos, convênios).

Experiência com frameworks de priorização : Conhecimento em frameworks como RICE, MoSCoW, Value vs. Effort, Kano, entre outros, para auxiliar na priorização de iniciativas.

Conhecimento em Product Discovery : Domínio das etapas de discovery contínuo, entrevistas com usuários, mapeamento de jornada, análise de concorrência e prototipação rápida.

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Escalation Leadership

Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues

Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations

Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues

Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators

title: Business Development Associate
description:
Business Development Associate - Brazil

About Powertrust

Powertrust is unlocking a new sector of clean energy by aggregating Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) from small, distributed renewable energy (DRE) projects around the world. We believe that small projects – aggregated to meaningful scale – can transform the world’s energy future by delivering social and climate impacts where it matters most. Small DRE projects help power schools, hospitals, factories, farms, and households across the Global South. Powertrust aggregates small DRE projects in an accountable, transparent way that matches how global corporations that are seeking to reduce their electricity emissions have procured renewables for the past decade. We offer a unique, innovative model for corporate climate leaders to decarbonize their global energy footprint while maximizing the impact of their investments.

Scope of Work

We are actively recruiting a proactive Business Development Associate based in Brazil to expand and curate our network of solar developers and facilitate the REC certification process. This role combines relationship-building, project coordination, and market intelligence to help scale renewable energy adoption in Brazil and across Latin America. The Business Development Associate will work closely with the global Powertrust project supply team, and will undertake the following responsibilities :

Solar Developer Outreach & Relationship Management

  • Proactively generate leads through outbound prospecting, networking, and industry events to build a strong pipeline of solar developers
  • Conduct strategic conversations with decision-makers at solar developers (C-Suite, VP-level) to understand financing requirements and position Powertrust’s REC solutions
  • Track KPIs such as qualified opportunities, conversion rates, and capacity targets; report regularly to leadership
  • Maintain strong relationships with developers, EPCs, and project owners across the Powertrust contracting lifecycle.
  • Represent Powertrust at solar expos and client meetings across Brazil to strengthen partnerships and close deals.

Project Facilitation & Data Coordination

  • Prepare proposals, support contract negotiations, and ensure smooth handoff to operations teams.
  • Work closely with the solar developers to manage their projects on the Powertrust digital platform and provide feedback to the technology team to make continuous improvements.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and third-party verifiers to streamline project onboarding and REC certification.
  • Maintain detailed records in CRM systems and track project milestones.

Market Research & Strategic Input

  • Analyze market trends and developer data to identify growth opportunities and inform strategic decisions in Brazil and across LATAM.
  • Provide feedback to improve developer experience and REC offerings.
  • Support business development campaigns and prepare presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

This is a full-time engagement, with the work expected to begin immediately.

Desired Skills and Experience

  • 3 – 5 years of B2B sales or business development experience, preferably in renewable energy or environmental commodities.
  • Experience in outbound prospecting and lead qualification at all organizational levels.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills; fluency in Portuguese and professional proficiency in English required.
  • Strong analytical skills with ability to create compelling presentations and reports for stakeholders.
  • Self-starter with ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
  • Familiarity with solar project development, permitting processes, energy markets, or REC processes is highly desirable.
  • Comfortable using CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot) and project management platforms.

Location and Travel

A successful candidate can be located anywhere in Brazil that supports building strong relationships across the solar ecosystem. The Business Development Associate will have a flexible working arrangement, working fully online from their own workspace and computer. Occasional travel may be required, as well as non‑standard work hours to accommodate international time zones.

Compensation

This role will pay R$160,000 annually; stock options or other performance incentives may be granted based on performance.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a note demonstrating why you are a good fit for this role to Unfortunately, we cannot respond to all applicants due to the high volume of applications we receive. You will only be contacted if your application is successful.

Associado de Desenvolvimento de Negócios - Brasil

Estamos recrutando ativamente um Associado de Desenvolvimento de Negócios proativo baseado no Brasil para expandir e fortalecer a nossa rede de desenvolvedores solares e facilitar o processo de certificação REC. Essa posição combina a construção de relacionamentos, a coordenação de projetos e a inteligência de mercado para ajudar a ampliar a adoção de energia renovável no Brasil e em toda a América Latina.

title: Social Copywriter & Content Creator
description:
Up to BRL 130,000 per year (depending on experience) on a full time, contractor contract Fully remote working anywhere in Brazil!

Work with the latest high-end hardware and creative software.

You’ll develop your AI edge — we’ll help you use and deepen your skills with AI tools so you stay ahead of the curve, not left behind by how the industry is changing.

A culture where ideas matter — your suggestions shape how we work.

⚡ Fast, flexible, and innovative — we move like a start-up with the backing of a global team.

Be part of a global team of 200+ talented colleagues.

Working hours :

9am – 5 : 30pm Pacific Time Zone, with a 1 hr lunch break

Role Snapshot

A copy-led, hands‑on creative role for a versatile social storyteller with a zeitgeist‑brain.

You’ll be part of the creative engine on one high‑profile entertainment account, spotting trends, pitching ideas, and turning TV and film moments into scroll‑stopping posts. You’ll focus on ideation, copywriting and simple asset creation, thinking in hooks, headlines and formats that feel native to each platform and fandom.

You’ll work day‑to‑day with producers, editors, designers and the Account Manager, helping to shape ideas, write sharp copy, create simple visuals and get content ready to ship.

It’s a genuinely fast‑paced agency environment with shifting priorities and tight deadlines, so you’ll need to enjoy that bit of pressure and stay calm and organised when things move quickly. You’ll also use AI in smart, safe ways to boost creativity and efficiency, keeping you ahead of the curve in this changing industry.

If you’re chronically online, obsessed with media and fandoms, and can speak fluent social, we want to hear from you.

Who You Are

  • ✅ Culture‑obsessed creative & social‑native storyteller : Chronically online, plugged into fandoms, memes and platform trends, and excited to turn them into smart ideas for TV and film IP. You think in hooks, formats and series, and understand how stories travel across different platforms.
  • ✅ Copy‑led thinker : Strong at short‑form writing, from punchy captions and headlines to on‑image lines and CTAs. You can flex tone of voice, write in social‑first language without being cringey and you know when less is more.
  • ✅ Resilient under pressure with high agency : You thrive in a fast‑moving environment with shifting priorities and tight deadlines. You spot problems and opportunities and take ownership of your work, raising issues early and helping to fix or pursue them without waiting to be asked.
  • ✅ Clear, confident communicator : Able to pitch ideas, give feedback and handle client comments calmly, clearly and constructively.
  • ✅ Supportive team player : You’re comfortable collaborating within a small team, taking direction from senior colleagues, helping to keep everyone aligned and stepping up to lead parts of projects when needed.
  • ✅ Organized producer : Strong on deadlines, details and juggling multiple titles at once, while keeping your briefs, docs and content trackers accurate.
  • ✅ AI‑fluent creator : You already use AI tools and LLMs to boost your creativity and speed, and you’re curious about weaving them into everyday workflows.
  • ✅ Driven by doing great work : Energized by smart, well‑crafted content, proud of the output, and focused on delivering for both clients and fans.

Not required but nice to haves

Entertainment or fandom experience — working on film / TV, streaming, gaming or other fandom‑heavy brands.

Who We Are

At Storm Ideas, we supercharge the digital presence of some of the biggest names in US TV and entertainment. Since 2008, our international team has delivered bold, forward‑thinking solutions for globally recognised clients.

Whether we're building innovative products, producing high‑impact social content, or designing smarter ways for our partners to work—we’re right at the cutting edge of creativity, technology, and automation.

Embracing Future‑Facing Technology

Emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence present exciting opportunities for us and our clients. As the world adapts, we’re committed to safely exploring the potential advantages of AI, integrating it thoughtfully into our work where possible, and one day guiding our clients through new possibilities when they’re open and ready for them. By tapping into our creativity, expertise, and collaboration, we aim to embrace its potential together. Our vision relies on people who are curious about this technology and excited to take on this challenge!

What You’ll Make Happen

  • Pitch social‑first ideas for TV and film titles, turning brand priorities, fandom insights and social trends into clear, platform‑native concepts (reactive and always‑on).
  • Write platform‑specific copy (captions, headlines, on‑image text) that feels native to TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, Threads etc., and true to the brand tone of voice.
  • Shape hooks and formats: Turn loose ideas into concrete post formats or series with clear angles, structures and examples that an editor or designer can run with.
  • Comb through episodes, films, trailers and clips to surface the strongest social moments, tagging and time‑coding them into clear hooks and formats for editors and designers to build from.
  • Turn ideas into tight briefs for editors and designers, with references, key lines, basic specs and deliverables outlined clearly.
  • Create simple visual assets yourself using templates (e.g. text‑on‑image, carousels, basic layouts) that are on‑brand and ready for publishing.
  • Support basic production tracking for your ideas: keep content trackers up to date, flag risks early, and help keep delivery on schedule for your posts.
  • Run quality checks on your content before delivery, catching typos, off‑brand phrasing or non‑compliance with specs and platform requirements.
  • Use AI tools and LLMs to boost your output, from idea and angle exploration, to alt lines and copy polishing, to generating variations and contribute to evolving how we use AI in our workflows.

Application

Along with your CV, please send us a cover letter that tells us why you’re the perfect fit for this role, PLUS, make us a meme! Try your best to make us laugh with a simple text‑on‑image meme using TV or Film IP. We’d also LOVE if you could let us know your current favourite social media trend and why!

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

Initial Video Questions

If shortlisted, you’ll be invited to complete a short set of questions via our online video platform.

First Interview

You’ll then have an interview with a member of our recruitment team to discuss your experience, skills, and interest in the role.

Creative Task (if applicable)

We may ask you to prepare a few creative ideas or examples of your work ahead of the next stage.

Final Interview

The final stage will be an interview with Louise Sables, our CEO and Nina Bicket, Head of Content Production. This is your opportunity to talk in more depth about your creative approach and how you could contribute to our team.

Not sure if you tick every box? Apply anyway — we value potential, mindset, and ambition as much as experience.

Somos uma operação real, lucrativa, em escala, resolvendo problemas complexos de otimização econômica no mundo físico.

title: Gerente de planejamento comercial
description:
Vaga : Gerente de Planejamento Comercial

Localização: Rio de Janeiro, RJ

Estruturar e gerenciar o planejamento estratégico das coleções, liderando a equipe de especialistas, analistas e assistentes de planejamento com foco no ciclo de vida do produto e na otimização do merchandising. O profissional será responsável por garantir a assertividade do mix de produtos, gerenciar o orçamento de compras (OTB) e otimizar os níveis de estoque, visando maximizar as vendas, o giro e a rentabilidade do negócio, enquanto desenvolve e orienta seu time.

Principais Responsabilidades

  1. Planejamento de Produto e Coleção (Pré-Temporada)
    • Análise de Performance: Supervisionar a análise de dados históricos de vendas (curva de produtos, categorias, atributos) para identificar tendências, oportunidades e riscos.
    • Construção do OTB (Open-to-Buy): Desenvolver e gerenciar o orçamento de compras (OTB) por coleção e categoria, alinhado às metas financeiras da companhia.
    • Definição do Sortimento (Mix): Liderar as discussões com as áreas de Estilo e Compras para definir a arquitetura da coleção (pirâmide de produtos, mix, amplitude vs. profundidade).
    • Planejamento de Demanda: Garantir a acuracidade do forecast de vendas e da projeção de necessidades de compra (compra inicial vs. reposição).
  2. Planejamento de Merchandising (Durante a Temporada)
    • Gestão de Estoque: Monitorar e direcionar o time na análise da performance do estoque (cobertura, giro, sell-through) e no gerenciamento do fluxo de produtos.
    • Alocação e Abastecimento: Definir e supervisionar a estratégia de distribuição inicial (alocação) e o plano de reposição (abastecimento) para as lojas e canais.
    • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida: Orientar a equipe na identificação de produtos (Best Sellers, Slow Movers) e liderar a proposição de ações comerciais (promoções, remarcações) para otimizar o ciclo de vida.
    • Planejamento de Liquidação: Estruturar a estratégia de markdown (remarcação) ao final da coleção, visando a limpeza do estoque com o mínimo impacto na margem.
  3. Gestão de Equipe e Performance
    • Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe de analistas e planejadores, orientando as entregas diárias e promovendo o crescimento profissional do time.
    • Gestão de Desempenho: Definir metas e KPIs para a equipe, acompanhando a performance individual e coletiva através de feedbacks e planos de desenvolvimento.
    • Controle de Qualidade: Assegurar a precisão, a qualidade e o cumprimento de prazos de todas as entregas, relatórios e análises da área.
    • Consolidação de KPIs: Ser o guardião dos indicadores de planejamento (Giro, Cobertura, Sell-Through, Margem, GMROI), consolidando os resultados e criando planos de ação.
    • Interface Estratégica: Liderar a interface e atuar como o principal ponto de contato entre as áreas de Compras, Estilo, Logística e Vendas, garantindo o alinhamento do planejamento.

Requisitos Essenciais

  • Experiência: Sólida experiência prévia em Planejamento Comercial, Produto ou Merchandising, adquirida obrigatoriamente no Varejo de Moda.
  • Gestão de Pessoas: Comprovada experiência em gestão de equipes (supervisão, coordenação ou gerência), mesmo que de times pequenos.
  • Competências Técnicas: Domínio avançado em Excel (modelagem, tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas complexas). Profundo conhecimento em gestão de OTB (Open-to-Buy). Ampla vivência com os principais indicadores de varejo (KPIs) e do ciclo de vida do produto.
  • Perfil: Capacidade de liderar, inspirar e desenvolver pessoas. Perfil altamente analítico, estruturado e com forte raciocínio lógico. Habilidade de transformar dados complexos em insights acionáveis. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociar e influenciar áreas parceiras.
  • Formação: Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Moda (com foco em Negócios) ou áreas correlatas.

Diferenciais (Desejável)

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Varejo, Finanças ou Negócios ou afins.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experiência com planejamento em múltiplos canais (Omnichannel - Lojas Físicas e E-commerce).

Metrics

  • Data‑driven decision‑making
  • Experience in hiring & onboarding

Strong Plus

  • Technical degree (engineering / CS / math)

description:
Native / Bilingual English is required for this role (read / written / spoken). Please upload your CV Resume in English.

Monthly salary : $6,000 USD

Along with our partner, we are seeking a security‑conscious contract Senior level Software Engineer to help enhance the security posture of their applications. The primary focus of this role is to systematically reduce their attack surface by addressing high‑priority security risks. Using Snyk as the primary scanning tool, this engineer will be responsible for identifying, prioritizing, and remediating dependencies with known exploitable vulnerabilities. The goal is a targeted reduction of risk, not a simple "update‑all" approach.

Role & Responsibilities

  • Vulnerability Analysis: Analyze the results of Snyk scans of their codebases (Ruby, Go, Python, JavaScript).
  • Prioritization: Critically assess Snyk reports to distinguish between theoretical vulnerabilities and those that are genuinely exploitable within the context of their applications.
  • Targeted Remediation: Plan and execute targeted dependency upgrades or apply patches specifically to fix the prioritized exploitable vulnerabilities, ensuring minimal disruption to the system.
  • Code & Test Validation: Refactor code and update unit / integration tests as necessary to support the upgraded dependencies and validate the fixes.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Work closely with internal security and engineering teams, participate in code reviews, and clearly document the rationale for each remediation.

Required Skills & Qualifications (Must-Haves)

  • Security Tooling: Proven professional experience using Snyk to identify, prioritize, and manage vulnerabilities in a production environment. Candidate must be able to interpret Snyk's findings, including exploit maturity and reachability.
  • Strong professional experience with all of the following languages: Ruby (including Ruby on Rails), Go, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript.
  • Deep expertise with package managers for each ecosystem (e.g., package.json, Go Modules, Pip / Poetry, NPM / Yarn).
  • Version Control: Expert-level proficiency with Git.
  • Automated Testing: A strong commitment to quality with proven experience in writing comprehensive tests.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves)

  • Other Security Tools: Familiarity with other SAST / SCA tools (e.g., GitHub Advanced Security, Checkmarx, Trivy).
  • CI / CD Integration: Experience integrating security tools like Snyk into CI / CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
  • Containerization: Experience with Docker and container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes).

Benefits

  • A fully remote position, allowing for work‑life balance.
  • The opportunity to be a part of a mission‑driven company that is committed to taking care of its employees.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

US Eastern Standard Time

About the Role

Mindhive builds AI-powered vision systems that transform industrial production. As we scale globally, reliability, observability, and rapid issue response are critical. The Platform Operations Team Lead (Brazil) plays a central role in ensuring our systems remain healthy across LATAM and European time zones.

You will lead the Platform Operations function — the customer-adjacent, reliability-focused counterpart to our Platform Engineering team in New Zealand. Your team will ensure our deployed systems are monitored, stable, recoverable, and well-understood by the rest of the business.

This role focuses on:

  • monitoring, alert quality, and fast incident response
  • supporting on-premise and edge deployments
  • improving operational processes and tooling
  • follow-the-sun coverage across Brazil and Portugal
  • ensuring operational readiness for engineering-led upgrades

You will collaborate closely with the NZ-based Platform Engineering team, who drive deep engineering projects (Puppet 8 rollout, Python 3.13 upgrade, CDK migration, CI / CD consistency, platform hardening, test-rig reliability). Together, you will form Mindhive’s global reliability backbone.

This is a hands-on leadership role with high impact on customer experience, system uptime, and our ability to scale installations worldwide.

About You

You are a strong operational leader with deep hands‑on technical skills. You thrive in live production environments, enjoy solving real‑world system issues, and understand how to build reliable systems across time zones. You excel in:

  • structured incident response
  • observability and monitoring
  • improving operational processes
  • leading teams in distributed, multicultural environments
  • working close to customers to ensure uptime and stability

You care about technical quality, clarity, and people — and you bring a mindset focused on resilience, collaboration, and steady improvement.

Key Competencies

  • Operational Excellence - builds systems, processes, and behaviours that improve stability and reliability.
  • Leadership & Mentorship - develops engineers and coordinates distributed teams.
  • Systems Thinking - sees the interplay between cloud, edge hardware, software, people, and processes.
  • Collaboration - works closely and constructively with NZ Platform Engineering and cross‑functional teams.
  • Calm Under Pressure - handles incidents and live issues with clarity and good judgement.
  • Continuous Improvement - always looking for ways to automate, simplify, and strengthen operations.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Operations Leadership

  • Lead and grow the Platform Operations team across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Build a high‑performing follow‑the‑sun operational capability that supports both internal teams and customers.
  • Establish clear daily operational rhythms, including alert review, ticket management, and incident response.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Mentor engineers and technicians across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure communication is clear, predictable, and aligned with our values.
  • Build a team that is highly accountable, collaborative, and customer‑focused.

Observability & Monitoring

  • Own the quality and accuracy of Datadog dashboards, alerts, service catalog, resource catalog, and operational visibility.
  • Reduce alert noise, improve signal quality, and ensure teams receive actionable information.
  • Develop and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and operational documentation.

Incident Response & Reliability

  • Oversee first‑line and second‑line incident response during LATAM and EU hours.
  • Ensure fast, structured triage for issues across cloud, on‑premise, and edge deployments.
  • Maintain clear escalation paths and strong communication practices during incidents.
  • Partner with Implementation and Customer Success teams to resolve client‑facing issues.

Collaboration with Platform Engineering (NZ)

  • Act as the operational counterpart to NZ Platform Engineering.
  • Ensure operational readiness for major engineering initiatives, such as:
  • Puppet 8 migration
  • Python 3.13 upgrade
  • CDK migration
  • CI / CD unification
  • Platform hardening
  • Test rig and E2E reliability improvements
  • Provide field feedback, operational insights, and rollout support for these improvements.

System Health & Operational Excellence

  • Monitor the health of live systems across sites and proactively identify stability risks.
  • Help drive improvements in:
  • edge hardware reliability
  • network stability
  • server provisioning consistency
  • observability for both cloud and on‑prem components
  • Work with teams to reduce operational toil and automate repetitive tasks.

Required Skills & Experience

Leadership & Communication

  • Experience leading distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Excellent communication in English and Portuguese.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, implementation, and customer‑facing teams.
  • Strong organisational skills with ability to manage competing priorities.

Technical

  • Strong background in DevOps, SRE, or Production Engineering environments.
  • Hands‑on experience operating hybrid cloud + on‑premise / edge systems.
  • Proficiency with:
  • Datadog (or similar observability platforms)
  • AWS (IAM, networking, security, monitoring)
  • Containerization (Docker)
  • Kubernetes / K3S
  • IaC tools (AWS CDK ideal)
  • Solid programming skills in Python (TypeScript / JavaScript is a plus).
  • Understanding of security best practices (identity, access, endpoint, and network security).

Operational

  • Experience running incident response, on‑call processes, or follow‑the‑sun operations.
  • Proven ability to write and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and operational documentation.
  • Experience supporting industrial, IoT, or hardware‑integrated systems (ideal).

About Us

Mindhive Ltd is a fast‑moving AI company using machine learning and computer vision to reimagine industrial systems. Our products run across cloud, on‑premise, and edge deployments, bringing AI performance and reliability directly to the factory floor.

We care deeply about people, quality, and impact. We work collaboratively, iterate quickly, and tackle meaningful, complex problems.

Mindhive is a New Zealand Hi‑Tech Awards winner, recognised for innovation and impact in software, AI, and advanced manufacturing.

Work Environment & Flexibility

We support hybrid and remote work, with our people distributed across Brazil, Portugal, Italy, Japan and New Zealand. We trust each other to deliver results in ways that suit our lives while maximising our collective impact. We move quickly, adapt fast, and support each other through the ups and downs that come with building something new and meaningful.

Our values

  • Relentless Curiosity - we explore deeply, question assumptions, and seek better ways.
  • Authentic Humanity - we support and care for people first.
  • Inclusive Connection - we collaborate openly and build strong relationships with customers and colleagues.
  • Determination to Deliver - we strive to do the right thing, consistently and with purpose.
